title: observability: token-level metrics + tracing + logging dashboard and alert tuning
author: Samira Gupta
description: Context: Customers have been asking for clearer per-token cost and latency visibility tied to KV cache behavior and spans so platform teams can correlate regressions with model rollouts and cache misses. This PR adds token-level cost/latency metrics, enriches tracing spans with KV/cache attributes, consolidates the tenant-facing dashboard, and tunes alert thresholds to reduce noise. Motivation: reduce incident triage time and give teams actionable levers (batching, cache TTL, model variant routing) from a single dashboard. Changes include dashboards, Prometheus/stack definitions, tracer attribute additions, and documentation. Checklist: [x] token-level metrics implemented and emitted, [x] tracing spans enriched, [x] dashboard panels added and grouped by route/model/tenant, [x] alert rules tuned and grouped with lifecycle (warning/critical), [x] docs updated with examples and recommended playbooks, [x] smoke-tested on staging, [x] load-tested with synthetic traffic. Related: Linear ENG-8421 (token observability), ENG-8574 (kv-cache metrics), SUP-5421 (support case referencing noisy alerts). Notes: kept change set minimal in runtime hot paths (metrics are emitted with async batching), dashboard only loads derived panels (no heavy queries by default), and alert tuning adopts percentile-based thresholds to avoid tail sensitivity.
